faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions
faq.q1: What do I need to place an order?
faq.a1: Contact us via phone or website to place an order. If you have a ready design, send the file, otherwise we also provide design services.
faq.q2: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.a2: Minimum order quantity varies by service type. Business cards — 100 pcs, banners — 1 pc, packaging — negotiated per batch.
faq.q3: How long does an order take?
faq.a3: Standard orders are completed in 1-3 business days, complex projects in 5-7 business days. Express service is also available (with additional charge).
faq.a4: Yes, free delivery is available within Tashkent city. We ship to regions via postal service.
faq.a5: Cash, bank transfer, Payme, Click and Uzum payments are accepted. Invoices are issued for legal entities.
